set.body:
Objective
Publish an independent acceptance record resolving identity, provider ownership, scope, baseline, calibration and budget decisions. This is the M0 exit review, not implementation self-certification.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements FND-01, FND-02, FND-06, FND-08, NUM-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
independent audit; M0 deliverables; PRD requirement and migration ledgers. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M0.02, M0.03, M0.04, M0.05, M0.06. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Reproduce selected provider/axis/poison-source checks from frozen revisions on both platforms.
2. Every existing method has a destination and removal gate; no unowned provider or scientific assumption gap is marked resolved.
3. Record Pass, explicit refusal, approved caveat or unresolved failure per scenario; passing engineering checks do not approve statistical claims.
4. Confirm the next ready work packets can implement one shared core without competing type hierarchies.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M0.07: Independently review and accept the foundation contracts
